feeds.title: Katie Jobling Blog » Acrylic Painting
feeds.description: I am UK based artist who focuses on documenting life using paint & my paintbrush. I believe it is so important for us to fill our homes with things that make us happy, which is why I started creating art and dressing my home with colours I love. In my blog I aim to give you an insight into my daily work life. Including some tips you'd like to try painting yourself, and how to stay inspired

feeds.title: Jackson's Art Blog
feeds.description: Founded in London in 2000, Jackson's offers a vast range of art materials to artists from all over the world. Jackson's Art Blog is a friendly place for artists to talk about their work, techniques, and materials. With our expertise and knowledge and as a team of practicing artists, we are dedicated to helping you find the colors, surfaces, brushes, and tools that you need for your practice.

feeds.title: Louise Luton Blog
feeds.description: My studio is in the historic city of Salisbury, Wiltshire, UK I create oil paintings inspired by nature. I combine naturalism with expressive colour to create something beautiful, quirky and a joy to look at.
